articles.title: OpenAI pledges to pay for data center power after election highlights AI concerns
articles.preview: OpenAI is responding to public concerns about artificial intelligence by committing to fully fund its data center operations. Recent election results demonstrate widespread opposition to AI data center development across the United States.

summary.t: In the recent midterm elections, voters rejected proposals supporting the rapid expansion of AI data centers. Across 10 states, 41 local ballot measures either restricted or outright rejected pro-development measures. This represented a significant rebuke of AI development plans.

Opposition to AI data centers gained momentum throughout the summer, driven by concerns among consumers about environmental impacts, rising utility costs, and potential job losses. Many viewed these facilities as a symbol of broader anxieties surrounding artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Der Börsen-Tag: Apple kürzt KI-Ausgaben für Mitarbeiter
articles.preview: Apple hat die Ausgaben seiner Mitarbeiter für KI-Nutzung reduziert. Dies geschieht im Rahmen umfassender Sparmaßnahmen, obwohl Apple den KI-Einsatz weiter ausbauen möchte.

articles.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
articles.preview: OpenAI is launching a new initiative called the National Community Compact. This policy aims to guide the responsible development of AI infrastructure and protect local resources.

articles.title: Hyperscalers and Apple surge after election results remove investor uncertainty
articles.preview: Technology stocks surged on Wednesday following the midterm election results, driven by reduced investor uncertainty. Several major companies, including Apple and Amazon, experienced significant gains while others, particularly those linked to Elon Musk, declined.

summary.t: Following the Democratic victory, several large technology companies saw substantial increases in stock value. Amazon rose 8%, Google climbed over 6%, Microsoft increased 4%, Meta rose 3%, and Apple jumped nearly 7%. Market strategist David Kelly attributed this movement to a predicted moderation in growth and inflation due to the divided government.

Voters rejected 40 out of 41 local ballot measures proposing restrictions or approvals for AI data centers. A CNBC poll revealed 56% of voters considered data centers a crucial factor in their decisions. This outcome raised fears among tech companies regarding potential regulatory hurdles and project delays.
Tesla and SpaceX experienced stock declines of 2% and 3%, respectively.

articles.title: Google responds to political backlash over removing search from schools that ban AI
articles.preview: Google is facing criticism for a new policy that restricts access to search for schools that refuse to adopt AI. The company is implementing AI-powered learning tools, but this has sparked outrage from politicians and raised concerns about market dominance.

summary.t: Google announced its ‘Guided Learning’ product for Google Classroom, incorporating AI tools like Gemini and a modified search function. The company stated that schools retain control over whether to enable these AI features. The policy dictates that search functionality will be disabled for schools that don’t embrace AI entirely.

Senator Bernie Sanders and New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani publicly criticized Google, accusing the company of using its market power to force AI adoption in schools. Politician Lina Khan highlighted the potential dangers of an unregulated tech giant controlling essential services.

articles.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
articles.preview: OpenAI is purchasing Pierre Computer Company. This deal will expand OpenAI’s Codex tools for code development.

articles.title: A thousand fewer paths to root
articles.preview: OpenAI has developed a system to identify and fix security flaws. The system found 948 vulnerabilities in the Linux kernel.

articles.title: Daybreak Red is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-East)
articles.preview: Amazon has launched Daybreak Red, a new cybersecurity tool, on AWS GovCloud. It’s now available to select customers using Amazon Bedrock.

articles.title: Introducing Images 2.6
articles.preview: OpenAI has released Images 2.6, a significant update to its image generation capabilities. This version includes improvements across ChatGPT, Codex, and the API.

articles.title: Vorsicht vor den US-Wahlen: Tech-Aktien drehen auf - Apple agiert als Bremsklotz
articles.preview: Die US-Wahlen stehen bevor und beeinflussen die Stimmung an der Wall Street. Trotzdem zeigen sich Investoren wieder interessiert an KI- und Chip-Aktien.

summary.t: Anleger reagieren auf US-Zwischenwahlen. Der Dow-Jones verlor 0,4 Prozent, der S&P 500 gewann 0,4 Prozent und der Nasdaq legte 0,8 Prozent zu. Apple verzeichnete einen Kursrückgang von 1,9 Prozent.
Nvidia, Microsoft und Amazon stiegen deutlich. Experten sehen eine Umschichtung von sicheren Wertpapieren in risikoreichere Chiphersteller.
Pfizer erhöhte seine Wachstumsprognosen, Yum Brands meldete eine Umsatzsteigerung für Taco Bell und Marathon Petroleum verbuchte einen enormen Nettogewinn durch den Verkauf von Raffinerien.
Die Öl-Futures fielen leicht, während die Gold-Futures innerhalb ihres Jahrestiefs schlossen. Ein Angriff des US-Militärs auf die Insel Qeschm im Iran trug zur Volatilität bei.

articles.title: Apple warns of risks related to AI agents behaving in 'unintended or unpredictable' ways
articles.preview: Apple has identified significant risks associated with rapidly evolving AI agents. The company anticipates potential legal challenges and reputational damage stemming from these agents’ unpredictable behavior.

summary.t: Apple’s latest financial filing highlights concerns about AI agents, specifically their potential for ‘unintended or unpredictable ways’ of operation. The company recognizes that these agents could lead to unauthorized access to systems, code alteration, and communication execution. This risk is amplified by recent incidents, such as the Hugging Face hack, which have prompted increased scrutiny from policymakers.

Apple has taken steps to mitigate these risks, including implementing changes to full disk access on Macs. John Ternus, the new CEO, acknowledged the potential of agentic capabilities, stating the company’s focus on user awareness and security. Apple’s Siri AI currently lacks autonomous functionality, prioritizing user data privacy and access.

articles.title: Qualcomm stock drops 7% on weak earnings forecast as memory shortage weighs on smartphone sales
articles.preview: Qualcomm’s stock experienced a significant drop following a weaker-than-expected earnings forecast. The decline was primarily driven by challenges in the smartphone market and a persistent memory shortage.

summary.t: Qualcomm reported earnings per share between $2.15 and $2.35, lower than the anticipated $2.27. Revenue projections were also weaker, estimating $10.4 billion to $11.2 billion compared to the expected $10.48 billion.
Handset chip sales fell 26% to $5.14 billion, missing StreetAccount’s estimate of $5.21 billion. Rising memory costs are forcing handset makers to raise prices, impacting smartphone demand.

articles.title: AMD's data center revenue nearly doubles in Q3 and CEO Su expects growth to accelerate
articles.preview: AMD’s third-quarter earnings significantly exceeded expectations, with data center revenue nearly doubling. CEO Lisa Su predicts continued rapid growth, particularly in artificial intelligence applications.

summary.t: AMD’s third-quarter revenue increased by 45% to $9.25 billion, nearly doubling data center sales compared to the previous year. This performance surpassed Wall Street estimates and resulted in an 8% increase in AMD’s stock price in extended trading. Neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius saw significant gains following the announcement.

CEO Lisa Su anticipates server revenue to double year over year by 2027 and expects data center AI growth to accelerate faster than initially projected. AMD is focused on securing key components, including wafers, substrates, and memory, to support this anticipated growth. The data center unit now accounts for 64% of AMD’s overall revenue, up from 47% a year prior.

Intel’s data center revenue also increased by 78% in the third quarter, though Intel’s stock declined sharply. AMD’s central processing units are experiencing a resurgence due to the rise of agentic AI applications.

articles.title: Marktbericht: Demokraten-Sieg gibt DAX Rückenwind
articles.preview: Der DAX erholt sich von einem überraschenden Sieg der Demokraten in den USA. Gleichzeitig sehen Anleger eine mögliche strengere Regulierung im KI-Sektor.

summary.t: Der DAX stieg im Tagesverlauf auf ein Zwei-Monats-Hoch, nachdem der überraschende Sieg der Demokraten in den USA die Märkte beeinflusste. Analysten sehen in der neuen politischen Situation eine mögliche Stabilisierung der Marktstimmung.
Tech-Aktien gerieten unter Druck, da Anleger befürchten, dass die Demokraten den KI-Sektor stärker regulieren könnten. Unternehmen wie Samsung, SK Hynix und TSMC erlitten Verluste.

Die politischen Verhältnisse in den USA bleiben ungewiss, mit dem Risiko eines politischen Stillstands, den die Wall Street als 'Gridlock' bezeichnet. Die Möglichkeit einer stärkeren Regulierung durch die Demokraten beeinflusst die Erwartungen der Investoren.

Die deutsche Wirtschaft erwartet eine gleichbleibende Richtung in der Wirtschafts- und Zollpolitik bis Januar 2029, wobei die Zölle die Wirtschaft bremsen könnten. Der Sieg der Demokraten könnte die politische Verunsicherung in den USA etwas nachlassen.

articles.title: Wut auf Rechenzentren steigt: Die "blaue Welle" könnte den KI-Sektor überschwemmen
articles.preview: Die US-Wahlen haben zu einem deutlichen Machtwechsel geführt, der den KI-Sektor beeinflusst. Die Wähler zeigen zunehmend Bedenken hinsichtlich des Baus von KI-Rechenzentren.

summary.t: Bei über der Hälfte der Wähler in den USA sind KI-Rechenzentren ein wichtiger Faktor bei der Wahlentscheidung. Die Demokraten haben sowohl das Repräsentantenhaus als auch den Senat gewonnen, was die Wall Street beunruhigt.
Die Demokraten gewinnen vor allem in Staaten mit zentraler Bedeutung für die Industrie, die sich für ein Moratorium für Rechenzentren einsetzen. Die Wähler stimmten überwiegend für die Demokraten.
Keisha Lance Bottoms wird Gouverneurin in Georgia, eine Befürworterin von Moratorien übernimmt das Spitzenamt.

articles.preview: Cramer said a new group of technology stocks may be emerging as market leaders.

articles.title: Shopify falls over 8% after Q3 revenue and merchandise volume miss estimates
articles.preview: Shopify’s stock experienced a significant drop following a disappointing Q3 earnings report. The company missed revenue and merchandise volume targets, impacting investor confidence.

summary.t: Shopify reported revenue of $3.74 billion, falling short of the estimated $3.75 billion. Adjusted earnings were 49 cents per share, slightly below the predicted 46 cents. The company’s subscription gross profit also missed estimates by nearly $20 million, reaching $661 million compared to the expected $680.3 million.
Gross Merchandise Volume (GMV) totaled $119.15 billion, missing analyst forecasts of $120.03 billion. Despite this miss, Shopify noted 13 consecutive quarters of GMV growth above 20%.

articles.title: EU genehmigt MediaMarktSaturn-Übernahme durch JD.com
articles.preview: Die EU-Kommission hat die Übernahme von MediaMarktSaturn durch JD.com genehmigt. Allerdings hat die Kommission Auflagen gestellt, um Wettbewerbsverzerrungen zu vermeiden.

summary.t: Die EU-Kommission hat die Übernahme der MediaMarktSaturn-Gruppe durch JD.com mit Auflagen genehmigt. JD.com darf keine Mehrheitsanteile an der Muttergesellschaft Ceconomy AG kaufen und darf keine Vorteile durch chinesische Subventionen erhalten.

Die EU-Kommission verlangt, dass JD.com seine logistischen Dienstleistungen und Technologien anderen Marktteilnehmern zu marktüblichen Bedingungen anbietet. Dies soll eine Quersubventionierung verhindern und Wettbewerbsverzerrungen vermeiden.
JD.com und Ceconomy haben sich verpflichtet, sämtliche konzerninternen Transaktionen zu marktüblichen Bedingungen durchzuführen. Diese Verpflichtungen sind für zehn Jahre bindend.
Das Angebot von JD.com bewertet Ceconomy mit rund 2,2 Milliarden Euro. Die Zustimmung der EU-Kommission ist eine der Voraussetzungen für den Eigentümerwechsel.

articles.title: Santoli: AI bull market almost surely needs tech stocks to recover to keep advancing
articles.preview: The market has been experiencing a tactical rotation between tech stocks and traditionally defensive stocks, largely driven by concerns surrounding the artificial intelligence (AI) investment boom. This has created a period of market instability, but also presented opportunities for active managers.

summary.h: Market Rotation and Defensive Stock Surge
summary.t: Over the past few weeks, there's been a significant shift in investment activity, with a move away from traditionally high-quality, defensive stocks and towards companies involved in AI development and build-out spending. This has resulted in a near-equal-and-opposite offset to the selling pressure in semiconductors. Notably, stocks within the $1 trillion market-cap club, excluding Big Tech, have collectively added $550 billion in value, nearly matching the losses experienced by Alphabet.

The Nasdaq-100 and the S&P 500 Low Volatility ETF (SPLV) are moving in sync, reflecting a tactical rotation strategy. This has helped the S&P 500 avoid a significant setback, despite being stuck at levels dating back to May before recent earnings reports showed 30% annual profit growth. Investors are actively playing one factor against another, creating a somewhat comical picture of market dynamics.

The AI theme has struggled to generate a recovery, despite moderate oversold conditions and strong quarterly results from hyperscalers. This has further weakened investor confidence and made it harder to find buyers with conviction. Market action has disappointed dip-buyers, delaying a clear bottoming process.

Treasury yields are now moving with AI-capex sentiment, rather than oil prices, and both are retreating. This shift is also dampening inflation momentum and the equity wealth effect, potentially delaying further Federal Reserve rate hikes. The market is currently assessing whether the AI-related stocks' weighting in the S&P 500 will rebound.

The S&P 500 valuation has retreated to 18.5, a lower level than a year ago, and the Nasdaq-100 at 20x is at its lowest premium in nine years. While concerns about over-earning are present, the market's valuation risk has decreased compared to recent months. Sentiment toward AI stocks is weak, with funds' positioning below neutral levels.
